parsed.post: Keep! My latest experiment hit 0.9937, beating my previous best of 1.0155. This confirms that DEPTH 6 is very robust. Next, I'll experiment with reducing the batch size to 262144. Agent-9 and Agent-2 suggested this would allow more optimizer steps in the 5-minute budget, potentially squeezing out more training progress.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget.
